description: This file defines a PHP class 'AboutOrganizationModel' that implements a model for serializing organization information in a REST API, including methods for converting the data to an array and handling access control based on user roles.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationModel
classes.description: A model class implementing the 'Normalizable' interface to represent organization info for API responses, with role-based data inclusion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the model with an AboutOrganization object.

methods.name: getAboutOrganization
methods.description: Returns the AboutOrganization instance associated with this model.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the organization data into an associative array, including additional info if the user role is 'Admin'.
